database_table: notifications (id uuid, type, notifiable_type, notifiable_id, data json, read_at) — schema channel 'database' bawaan Laravel; title/body disimpan di dalam data
channel: Notifikasi in-app (database) + WebPush/PWA untuk web; sinkron ke Flutter via API
reminder_engine: Job ProcessPlantReminder dijalankan scheduler (php artisan schedule:run) setiap jam; reminder jatuh tempo dikirim & dijadwalkan ulang (next_due_at = last_done + frequency_days)
read_state: notifications.read_at null = belum dibaca; badge jumlah belum dibaca di UI
